summary: Fourteen generic drawings were replaced with original illustrations based on inspected OEM photos and front-view diagrams. All 102 profiles retain their hardware facts and FAE distinctions. Current integrated card, source-disclosure, comparison, redirect and responsive checks passed.
strengths: The ten new profiles and four older generic illustrations now show source-inspected example configurations.
All 102 cards retain prominent processor counts, DIMM slots, DPC and per-server or per-node scope.
The earlier blade, tower and formatting corrections remain intact. Every non-art catalog field is protected against unintended edits.
The Finder and all five OEM learning guides use the same reviewed artwork; reference details and configuration limits remain accessible.
limitations: HPE ProLiant XD245/XD285 and Supermicro SBA-817V7-1N remain explicitly labeled contextual schematics because exact isolated-model exteriors were not established.
Drawings represent documented example configurations, not simultaneous storage/CPU/GPU maxima.
This is a fresh physical-reference review of 14 illustrations and a layout/preservation review across 102 profiles; it is not a fresh source audit of every hardware specification.
Coverage is curated and partial. Exact configuration and orderability require OEM confirmation; HPE QuickSpecs remain primary HPE configuration evidence.
Public publication remains a separate owner action.

upstream.scope: The prior browser results apply to the separate v1.2 source release. They are retained in the build inputs and are not evidence of this integrated interface.
